crossRefs.note: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

translations.web: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
translations.bsb: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.
translations.kjv: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
translations.asv: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth; Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
